AmbiguousEntity.description:
A CAD entity that could not be interpreted with confidence, and why.

Ambiguous entities are reported and left out of the site model; they are
never silently used or dropped.
AmbiguousEntity.title: AmbiguousEntity

ArtifactKind.description: Kinds of versioned artifacts kept in a project store.
ArtifactKind.title: ArtifactKind

ArtifactRef.description: Pointer to one immutable version of an artifact, pinned by content hash.
ArtifactRef.title: ArtifactRef

BuildableEnvelope.description: Where the building may stand. Its source must be stated.
BuildableEnvelope.title: BuildableEnvelope

CadImportProvenance.description: Record of one CAD import (filled in by Milestone B adapters).
CadImportProvenance.title: CadImportProvenance

ClaimStatus.description: How an evaluator produced a reported value.
ClaimStatus.title: ClaimStatus

CompositeSpace.description:
One physical open room, partitioned into non-overlapping functional Space zones.

Child polygons retain program IDs and furniture studies. Their union is this
physical boundary; shared partitions are full-width/full-height open apertures.
CompositeSpace.title: CompositeSpace

ConfirmationStatus.description:
Status of a fact that must come from a source document or a human.

Used for drawing units, horizontal CRS and vertical datum. Nothing in the
system may move a value to USER_CONFIRMED on its own; only a human can.
ConfirmationStatus.title: ConfirmationStatus

Epistemic.description: Epistemic status of a statement about the project.
Epistemic.title: Epistemic

ExpectedFinding.description:
A metric comparison or count of findings, with explicit evidence status.

An unavailable future probe is NOT_CHECKED, never a successful regression.
A metric intentionally reporting NOT_CHECKED (e.g. unknown orientation) can
be asserted by setting status=not_checked and value=null instead.
ExpectedFinding.title: ExpectedFinding

HeightLabelCheck.description:
A height label drawn exactly at a surveyed point, compared with the point's z.

The label never becomes an elevation; it only corroborates (or disputes) the
point's own z value. Both values are in drawing units, as written.
HeightLabelCheck.title: HeightLabelCheck

Issue.description: An unresolved problem attached to a site, program or plan.
Issue.title: Issue

LocalCoordinateSystem.description: Rigid transform between GRID metres and the LOCAL project frame.
LocalCoordinateSystem.title: LocalCoordinateSystem

MaterialRef.description: A reference to a material; render/BIM details live in libraries.
MaterialRef.title: MaterialRef

Opening.description: A door, window or cased opening hosted by exactly one wall.
Opening.title: Opening

Polygon2D.description: A simple polygon, optionally with holes. Rings are not closed explicitly.
Polygon2D.title: Polygon2D

SpaceRelationship.description: A declared design intent between two spaces (geometry decides if it holds).
SpaceRelationship.title: SpaceRelationship

TerrainBreakline.description: Explicitly mapped surveyed 3D line; no inferred elevations or kerb roles.
TerrainBreakline.title: TerrainBreakline

TinSurface.description:
Triangulated terrain built only from surveyed points (LOCAL metres).

It covers the convex hull of the survey data and nothing more: elevations
outside it are unknown, never extrapolated.
TinSurface.title: TinSurface

UnitDeclaration.description: The length unit of a source drawing and how we know it.
UnitDeclaration.title: UnitDeclaration

VehicleEnvelope.description: Requested vehicle size; not a turning-radius or swept-path model.
VehicleEnvelope.title: VehicleEnvelope

Wall.description: A straight wall defined by its centerline on a level.
Wall.title: Wall
